answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 36280 Country: Bangladesh Title: I am Mohammad Kamrul Abedin from Bangladesh. I am going to marry next month Question: I am Mohammad Kamrul Abedin from Bangladesh. I am going to marry next month. My question is during sexual intercourse with my wife can I lick my wife's breast and vagina to enjoy the full sexual satisfaction and also while sexual intercourse can we do it in fully naked body, will it be Haram? Please answer me according to Islamic Shariah. Answer ID: 36280 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 187/L=104/TL=1433) At the time of intercourse, one can suck his wife's breast provided milk does not go to throat. However, it is not lawful to suck the vagina of wife; it is the way of animals. Also during intercourse, it is against etiquette to go completely naked. Hadith forbids it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
